headline: Asian Stock Markets Summary: Close (28th)
summary: Chinese stock markets closed lower, with biotechnology and semiconductor shares weighing, while commodity-related stocks rose; the Shanghai Composite fell 0.1%.
why: The Shanghai Composite tracks large listed companies on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and reflects sentiment in China's domestic equity market.
